nodes.label: Distributor
nodes.desc: Validates pushed pprof profiles against per-tenant limits, then routes every series to the configured write path.

nodes.label: Write Path Router
nodes.desc: Chooses between the v2 segment-writer path, the legacy ingester path, or both, per tenant configuration.

nodes.label: Segment Writer
nodes.desc: v2 component that shards profiles in memory and periodically flushes compact segments straight to object storage.

nodes.label: Ingester (legacy v1)
nodes.desc: Legacy ingester that keeps recent profiles in per-tenant PhlareDB heads on local disk before shipping blocks.

nodes.label: Object Storage
nodes.desc: Bucket abstraction over S3, GCS, Azure and other object stores that durably holds every profile block.

nodes.label: Metastore
nodes.desc: Raft-replicated index that records block metadata and serves block listings to readers.

nodes.label: Compactor
nodes.desc: Multitenant compactor that plans and manages background merging of small segments into larger blocks.

nodes.label: Read Path Router
nodes.desc: Splits queries by time between the legacy frontend and the v2 query frontend based on the oldest stored profile.

nodes.label: Query Frontend (v2)
nodes.desc: Fetches block metadata from the metastore, builds a distributed query plan and dispatches it to query backends.

nodes.label: Query Backend
nodes.desc: Executes MERGE and READ nodes of a query plan by reading blocks from object storage and merging results.

nodes.label: Querier (legacy)
nodes.desc: Legacy querier that fans out to ingesters and store-gateways over bidi streaming clients and merges series.

nodes.label: Store Gateway
nodes.desc: Serves queries against blocks in object storage, sharded across instances by a ring.
